title: Extensions and torsors on the Zariski site
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let X_Zar be its small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], and let G be an abelian sheaf on X_Zar [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. The isomorphism classes of G-torsors are canonically in bijection with equivalence classes of short exact sequences of abelian sheaves $0\to G\to E\to \mathbf Z_X\to0$, by sending a sequence to its fibre over 1 and sending a torsor T to the sheaf coproduct of its contracted powers $T^{\otimes n}$ for $n\in\mathbf Z$.

source.place: Lemma 02FQ (cohomology-lemma-torsors-h1), extension construction by contracted powers; the same proof applies to the Zariski site

proof.text: For a G-torsor T, the coproduct of contracted powers E = coproduct over n in Z of T^{\otimes n} has an abelian-sheaf structure by concatenation; the exponent map is a short exact sequence 0 \to G \to E \to Z_X \to 0 and its fibre over 1 is T.

source.place: Lemma 02FQ (cohomology-lemma-torsors-h1), construction of the extension by contracted powers

proof.text: Conversely, for every short exact sequence 0 \to G \to E \to Z_X \to 0, its fibre over 1 is a G-torsor, and sending the sequence to this fibre is inverse up to equivalence to the contracted-power construction: the addition in E identifies the fibre over n with T^{\otimes n} for every n in Z.
